title: Let's play and give feedback on each other's AI-assisted games!
author: vanerb11
selftext:
Hey everyone!

I'd love to check out what other developers are creating with the help of AI!

I thought it would be nice to organize a little feedback exchange. Share your game or demo in the comments, and I'll give it a try and leave you some honest feedback.

In return, I'd really appreciate it if you could check out my game too and share your thoughts!

**My game: Nova Collapse**  
[https://varkness-games.itch.io/nova-collapse](https://varkness-games.itch.io/nova-collapse)

It's a free space-themed Survivors-like where you control a growing star, collect upgrades, fight waves of enemies and decide when to trigger a supernova.

It's playable directly in your browser!

I'm happy to try different genres. Looking forward to discovering your projects and supporting fellow indie developers!

Let's help each other improve!
